...Big bro...?
Um... I'm Buu-chan. ...Nice to meet you, okay?

...! Yeah!
Yeah, mm-hmm...!

Still... you rushed here as fast as you could
just to make it in time, didn't you?

All right, everyone! Let's start the mock race~
Is everybody ready? On your marks... GO!!
...Huh?

Still... thank you.
I'll do my best too. ...I'm definitely going to get into Tracen Academy!
Go! ...Hyaaaaaaah!!

Seeing her run with everything she had for the first time
struck such a deep, powerful chord in my heart that—

B-But...! Look, I got so big!
I can carry you now, Big Sis! See...?!
...I remember being so excited that night that I couldn't sleep a wink.
Haah...—

...Big sis...?
Um... I'm Buu-chan. ...Nice to meet you, okay?

I remember watching her stubbornly persist, and finding
her rich—far too rich—sensitivity and kindness utterly endearing.
It has to be Special Week!

I remember taking the timidly outstretched tiny hand into my own,
and how her fluffy tail gave a gentle swish against her back.

"Ever since I first saw you run, the truth is..."
I continue, gathering my resolve and pounding my chest before her. "I've always—"

The other Umamusume give chase with everything they've got, but Special Week holds on!!
Number 13, Special Week, in the lead—crosses the finish line!!

Yep! You and I are going to study up together today!
Have you decided which Umamusume to keep an eye on in the Japan Cup? Hey—

I run with all my might. Toward our promised place.
Toward her.

It's Special Week! Special Week!!
Special Week takes the lead!!
...! Does that mean—

Thank you. I've been waiting for you all this time.
—Trainer!

...Hehe.
Are you okay? Your face is completely red.

When I first met her—Buena Vista—
we were both still very, very young.

My heart trembles. ...Starting today, my journey as an
Umamusume Trainer at Tracen Academy finally begins.
...Hey. Someday, without a doubt, we will too—!
—Pausing before the school gates, I gently touch the brand-new badge on my lapel.

B-But...! Look, I got so big!
I can carry you now, Big Bro! See...?!

"Ever since I first saw you run, the truth is..."
I continue, gathering my resolve and pounding my chest before her. "—"
What a magnificent view...!!

Buena Vista had successfully enrolled at Tracen Academy... and as for me,
one autumn day, I was studying furiously for the Trainer licensing exam.

(Amazing... Amazing, amazing, amazing!!
What a run, what an impact, what a roar from the crowd... What a—)
And just like that, a childhood promise transformed into an irreplaceable dream for the both of us.
...Yes!

I think it turned out better than the one I made
when you took your entrance exam~ ...Or at least, I'd like to think so. Hehehe.

...Mmh, come on! You know I'm a crybaby.
Springing that on me out of nowhere... is a little unfair, you know.

Japan's Supreme Commander, Special Week!! Defeating even the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe Umamusume,
she claims a glorious, magnificent victory in the Japan Cup!!
My destination has already been decided. —It was decided long, long ago.

Don't mention it! ...Ah, shoot, we need to head to the grandstand soon!
We want to grab spots with the best view possible, after all.

—Come now, say hello. This is <username>-chan,
who just moved in next door. Let's make sure we're good friends, okay?

Hehe... Yeah, not yet!!
Yaaaaaaah!!

—Wait, you're going to a Trainer Training Academy?!
And at the URA, no less...?!

Then, once more...
...May I hear it from you?

...I remember. It was some time after Buena Vista had started attending
a club where young Umamusume learned how to run.
"Someday, we're definitely going to reach a view like this."
*sniff* Uuuugh...! It hurts so much, doesn't it...? You're coughing and coughing... and your fever... uuuuugh...!

Her features had grown far more mature since those days. Yet that pure,
radiant brightness that struck straight to the heart remained unchanged.

A childhood promise made almost entirely on a whim.
The day it began to truly shine... was that day.
And then—...
Um... what do you think? Of the charm, I mean.
Toaaaaaaaah!!

—Come now, say hello. This is <username>-kun,
who just moved in next door. Let's make sure we're good friends, okay?
